events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Joseph S. Jones by Rev. P. J. Colligan; Luzerne docket no. 71238 (licence 26 Dec 1914). Agnes, 30, at home, b./res. Plymouth. [R4-S1]

bio:
Agnes M. McAvoy was born on 4 February 1884 at Plymouth, Pa., the daughter of William McAvoy, a native of New York, and Catharine Murphy, who was born in Schuylkill County. She was a sister of Elizabeth McAvoy. On 29 December 1914, at Plymouth, she married Joseph S. Jones, a brother of Anna C. Jones McGuire; by then her father had died and her mother was still living in Plymouth.

Agnes and Joseph had three children: Edward (1916–1995), Joseph (born 1918) and Kathryn Ann (1919–1995), who married Henry P. Derwin. Agnes died at Wilkes-Barre on 23 November 1958 and was buried at Larksville, Pa.
researchNotes: Her 1914 marriage docket names her parents William (deceased, born New York) and Catharine Murphy (living in Plymouth, born Schuylkill Co.) ([R4-S1]). Children (FS): Edward (1916-1995), Joseph (b. 1918) and Kathryn Ann (1919-1995, m. Henry P. Derwin) ([R4-S2]).
